Definition and coding: Unique historical concept test identifier. One row per concept.
Year the research was completed, 2022 to 2025.
Product category, Snacks, Drinks or Personal care.
Extent of change, Incremental improvement or New proposition.
Survey, Behavioural or Combined. Package contents are described in the dataset notes.
Number of consumers who completed the core questionnaire.
Total fee in euros for the historical test, excluding VAT, including recruitment and reporting.
Calendar days from confirmed brief to delivery of the research report.
Mean concept appeal rating, 1 unappealing to 7 appealing.
Mean stated purchase likelihood, 1 very unlikely to 7 very likely.
Percentage choosing the concept in a simulated choice among four options, 0 to 100.
Association task score, 0 to 100. Higher means faster positive than negative associations, using one common scoring scale.
Original research recommendation, Progress, Refine or Stop, recorded before launch.
Concept subsequently launched, 1 yes, 0 no. The business could override the recommendation.
Marketing spend in euros during the first 12 weeks after launch.
Percentage of target retail outlets stocking the product by week 12, 0 to 100.
First 12 weeks sales divided by the target agreed before launch, multiplied by 100. 100 means target met.
Percentage of tracked initial buyers purchasing again within 12 weeks, 0 to 100.
